messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The Customer Service Representative sends a Mortgage offer to the customer and waits for a reply. If the customer calls or writes back declining the mortgage, the case details are updated and the work is then archived prior to cancellation. If the customer sends back the completed offer documents and attaches all prerequisite documents then the case is moved to administration for completion. If all pre-requisite documents are not provided a message is generated to the customer requesting outstanding documents. If no answer is received after 2 weeks, the case details are updated prior to archive and cancellation.

  <process id="MortgageApplicationProcess" name="Mortgage Application Process" isExecutable="true">

    </startEvent>

    <!-- Task: Send Mortgage Offer -->
    <sendTask id="task_sendMortgageOffer" name="Send Mortgage Offer to Customer">
      <incoming>flow_start_to_sendOffer</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_sendOffer_to_eventBasedGateway</outgoing>
    </sendTask>

    <!-- Event-Based Gateway: Wait for Reply or Timeout -->
    <eventBasedGateway id="gateway_eventBased" name="Wait for Customer Response">
      <incoming>flow_sendOffer_to_eventBasedGateway</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_gateway_to_declineMessage</outgoing>
      <outgoing>flow_gateway_to_acceptMessage</outgoing>
      <outgoing>flow_gateway_to_timer</outgoing>
    </eventBasedGateway>

    <!-- Catch Event: Customer Declines -->
    <intermediateCatchEvent id="event_offerDeclined" name="Offer Declined (Call/Write)">
      <incoming>flow_gateway_to_declineMessage</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_decline_to_updateCaseDeclined</outgoing>
      <messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_Decline" />
    </intermediateCatchEvent>

    <!-- Catch Event: Customer Accepts / Sends Documents -->
    <intermediateCatchEvent id="event_offerAccepted" name="Offer Documents Received">
      <incoming>flow_gateway_to_acceptMessage</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_accept_to_checkDocs</outgoing>
      <messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_Accept" />
    </intermediateCatchEvent>

    <!-- Catch Event: 2 Weeks Timeout -->
    <intermediateCatchEvent id="event_twoWeeksTimeout" name="2 Weeks Timeout">
      <incoming>flow_gateway_to_timer</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_timer_to_updateCaseTimeout</outgoing>
      <timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDef_2Weeks">
        <timeDuration xsi:type="tFormalExpression">P14D</timeDuration>
      </timerEventDefinition>
    </intermediateCatchEvent>

    <!-- Task: Check Prerequisite Documents -->
    <userTask id="task_checkPrerequisiteDocs" name="Check Prerequisite Documents">
      <incoming>flow_accept_to_checkDocs</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_checkDocs_to_docsCompleteGateway</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <!-- Exclusive Gateway: Are all documents provided? -->
    <exclusiveGateway id="gateway_docsComplete" name="All prerequisite docs provided?">
      <incoming>flow_checkDocs_to_docsCompleteGateway</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_docsComplete_yes</outgoing>
      <outgoing>flow_docsComplete_no</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Task: Move Case to Administration -->
    <userTask id="task_moveCaseToAdmin" name="Move Case to Administration for Completion">
      <incoming>flow_docsComplete_yes</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_admin_to_endCompleted</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <!-- End Event: Completed -->
    <endEvent id="endEvent_completed" name="Case Completed">
      <incoming>flow_admin_to_endCompleted</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <!-- Task: Request Outstanding Documents -->
    <sendTask id="task_requestOutstandingDocs" name="Request Outstanding Documents from Customer">
      <incoming>flow_docsComplete_no</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_requestDocs_to_eventBasedGateway</outgoing>
    </sendTask>

    <!-- Task: Update Case Details (Declined) -->
    <userTask id="task_updateCaseDeclined" name="Update Case Details (Declined)">
      <incoming>flow_decline_to_updateCaseDeclined</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_updateDeclined_to_archive</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <!-- Task: Update Case Details (No Response) -->
    <userTask id="task_updateCaseTimeout" name="Update Case Details (No Response)">
      <incoming>flow_timer_to_updateCaseTimeout</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_updateTimeout_to_archive</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    <!-- Exclusive Gateway: Merge Cancellation Paths -->
    <exclusiveGateway id="gateway_mergeCancellation" name="Merge Cancellation">
      <incoming>flow_updateDeclined_to_archive</incoming>
      <incoming>flow_updateTimeout_to_archive</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_merge_to_archive</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Task: Archive Work -->
    <userTask id="task_archiveWork" name="Archive Work">
      <incoming>flow_merge_to_archive</incoming>
      <outgoing>flow_archive_to_endCancelled</outgoing>
    </userTask>

    </endEvent>

    <sequenceFlow id="flow_sendOffer_to_eventBasedGateway" sourceRef="task_sendMortgageOffer" targetRef="gateway_eventBased" />
    
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_gateway_to_declineMessage" sourceRef="gateway_eventBased" targetRef="event_offerDeclined" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_gateway_to_acceptMessage" sourceRef="gateway_eventBased" targetRef="event_offerAccepted" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_gateway_to_timer" sourceRef="gateway_eventBased" targetRef="event_twoWeeksTimeout" />

    <sequenceFlow id="flow_decline_to_updateCaseDeclined" sourceRef="event_offerDeclined" targetRef="task_updateCaseDeclined" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_timer_to_updateCaseTimeout" sourceRef="event_twoWeeksTimeout" targetRef="task_updateCaseTimeout" />

    <sequenceFlow id="flow_accept_to_checkDocs" sourceRef="event_offerAccepted" targetRef="task_checkPrerequisiteDocs" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_checkDocs_to_docsCompleteGateway" sourceRef="task_checkPrerequisiteDocs" targetRef="gateway_docsComplete" />

    <sequenceFlow id="flow_docsComplete_yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="gateway_docsComplete" targetRef="task_moveCaseToAdmin" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_docsComplete_no" name="No" sourceRef="gateway_docsComplete" targetRef="task_requestOutstandingDocs" />

    <sequenceFlow id="flow_admin_to_endCompleted" sourceRef="task_moveCaseToAdmin" targetRef="endEvent_completed" />

    <!-- Loop back after requesting documents -->
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_requestDocs_to_eventBasedGateway" sourceRef="task_requestOutstandingDocs" targetRef="gateway_eventBased" />

    <sequenceFlow id="flow_updateDeclined_to_archive" sourceRef="task_updateCaseDeclined" targetRef="gateway_mergeCancellation" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_updateTimeout_to_archive" sourceRef="task_updateCaseTimeout" targetRef="gateway_mergeCancellation" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_merge_to_archive" sourceRef="gateway_mergeCancellation" targetRef="task_archiveWork" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow_archive_to_endCancelled" sourceRef="task_archiveWork" targetRef="endEvent_cancelled" />
